Name: Pierre Costume for Morris - Spirit's Eve SVE or Morris Redeemed
Author: LeelooStardew
Description:
✅Clearance bin boyband wig
✅Thrifted faux leather jacket
✅The scent of desperation

Yep. It's a Pierre costume.

[b]Compatibility:[/b]
[list]
[*]Comes compatible with: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Slightly Cuter Aesthetic SVE[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12667]Morris Redeemed[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12824]Marry Morris[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47040]The Man The Morris[/url]. No configuration needed.[/*]
[*]This mod should override most custom Morris portrait and sprite replacers during Spirit’s Eve, but mods with their own Spirit’s Eve Morris assets may conflict unless specifically supported.[/*]
[/list][b]Requirements:[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12667]Morris Redeemed[/url] or[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12824] Marry Morris[/url]. [/*]
[/list]
Note: Morris will only attend Spirit’s Eve after you’ve progressed far enough through either SVE’s Joja storyline or the Morris Redeemed storyline.
